cache_methodology: Three sequential fresh encode processes on the same shared host after prior source reads; warm/unspecified OS cache. No cache eviction, CPU pinning or isolation. 24 encoder workers, OMP/OPENBLAS/MKL=1.
notes: Complete encode-process wall time includes startup, full inspection, exact preservation, candidate search, measured errors, quality arrays, writing, integrity checks and fsync/publication. Source verification is separate. No concurrent full-data encoding or imaging was launched by this task during the final repeats. Profiling is a separate run.
